reports.title: Belden Reports Record Third Quarter 2026 Results and Announces $100 Million Data Center Agreement for 2027

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: “Our fourth quarter outlook reflects strong underlying demand and the momentum we're building as one company with Ruckus," said Dr. Chand. "Orders are at record levels entering the quarter, our solutions pipeline continues to build, and we're seeing growing engagement from data center and physical AI customers. We remain disciplined given the near-term macroeconomic and supply chain environment, but the long-term fundamentals across our markets continue to strengthen. Our focus remains on execution, integration, and capturing the opportunity in front of us."
